app.title: PolyTalk - Privacy-first Self-hosted Translation
room.tagline: Each person speaks their own language and hears the others in theirs.
room.create_failed: Could not create the room. Is the server running?
room.headphones_hint: Without headphones, the microphone pauses while a translation plays so the phone does not translate its own sound.
room.enter_hint: Entering turns on the microphone and the sound. After that, just talk.
room.captions_empty: Translations of what the others say will appear here.
room.invite_hint: Point the other phone's camera at the code, or type the room code there.
room.tap_for_sound: Tap here to turn on the sound
room.wake_lock_unavailable: Keep the screen on: this browser cannot do it by itself.
room.mic_denied: Microphone access denied. Allow it in the browser and try again.
room.mic_unsupported: This browser cannot use the microphone here. Open the page over HTTPS in Chrome or Safari.
room.error_stage: A sentence could not be translated ({stage}).
room.license_note: Free software based on PolyTalk CE.
